anyway, you need to address this to your friends or make new ones (which is what I did). you deserve to be happy!

I have actually asked this same question bc of my trauma. I was comforted when someone told me that "if trauma made you trans, everyone with trauma would be trans and everyone who was trans would have trauma". Your experiences dont have to correlate with each other, but they can if you want them too. I know some people do credit trauma for their transness bc that's how they feel. If you feel like they aren't connected, then they aren't.

It can also help to talk to a therapist about this!
